name: 奧瑞恩男性偏文 · 雙手重刃
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: slender adult European-looking man with wavy dark auburn hair, ivory long academy coat with royal blue panels and gold piping, burgundy scarf, leather book belt and tall black boots. Held equipment MUST be: a broad two-handed greatsword with long grip, both hands grasping it. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Both hands lift heavy sword over shoulder, strong overhead diagonal chop and weighty follow-through. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: slender adult European-looking man with wavy dark auburn hair, ivory long academy coat with royal blue panels and gold piping, burgundy scarf, leather book belt and tall black boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
